expectations.text: Does not assume the day-to-day, ladder, or pay transfers from one operating context to the other.
expectations.evidence: Partly met. The answer contrasts the day-to-day of the two contexts: an in-house conference organizer (A: 'depth… programming, speakers, sponsor delivery, P&L') versus an agency ('several clients and deadlines at once', 'you execute the client's vision'). It also asks each company to confirm scope and workload. However, it assumes the ladder transfers. It says 'The senior title helps' without checking whether an in-house 'senior' title means the same thing at an agency or to freelance clients.
